text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After finishing some errands with Mejiro Bright, we return to the academy and bump into…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh! Greetings, Fukukitaru. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: …That's quite a large box you have there. Whatever could it be for?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! A fine question! Within this box resides a miracle-working object most divine—a jumbo lucky cat figurine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Today's breakfast natto fortune foretold that "luck would be found in the east." Thus, I ventured eastward.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: When, lo and behold, an extraordinary aura beckoned me into a flea market! And its origin was none other than this lucky cat figurine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now, if you'll excuse me, I must buff this cat until it shines like the morning sun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nnngh, just a little more aaand… Oh, oh, oh nooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shoop!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru stumbles. The box flies out of her hands and lands on the road.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: VROOOOM! Bump, bump, bump, bump…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: BY THE HEAVENS! My poor lucky cat is now a pile of unlucky roadkill!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, dear me… Trainer, let's lend our assistance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The cat is now an unrecognizable pile of debris. We gather up its pieces and take them back to my office, but…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ahhh… My lucky cat figurine has been reduced to kindling…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh, what are we to do?! Without immediate action, grave misfortune is sure to befall us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, but if I may make a suggestion…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Perhaps we could reassemble the lucky cat by piecing it back together?
choice_data_list: That's a lot easier said than done…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Your trainer's right, Bright! If the pieces were larger, it'd be another story! But we're working with fragments here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It might take some time, but I imagine we could restore it to its former glory. We should have all the pieces here, after all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… You're too kind…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Teehee! A friend in need is a friend indeed, after all. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we set to work on reconstructing the lucky cat figure…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Night falls, but we're nowhere near finished.
choice_data_list: We might have to work through the night…
We might have to work through the night…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nnngh… I'm starting to feel dizzy…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Bright, enough is enough… I shall inform the great Shiraoki of what's transpired, pray for forgiveness, and request that any evil spirits be exorcised…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Please, allow me to keep going for a little while longer… I've finally gotten used to the process.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Slow and steady gets the job done, after all. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the same energy she had when we started, Mejiro Bright continues fitting the pieces together without saying a word. Until…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn… Nghwaaa? When did I fall asleep?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: My stars?! The sun has begun its ascent toward the heavens! Morning is upon us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fukukitaru, please take a look.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whoa… WHOOOAAA?! C-can it be?! My lucky cat, restored to its former glory?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Bright, don't tell me you worked through the night without so much as a wink of sleep?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I did, but I was so focused on the task that I hardly noticed the time. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright has successfully finished the painstakingly intricate project in a single night…
choice_data_list: You didn't even look like you were struggling…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Talent? I wonder… I am quite adept at taking things one step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fukukitaru, should any of your other items happen to take a tumble, please don't hesitate to get in touch. ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Heaven forbid! Bright, I vow to take extra care in all that I do, so as not to trouble you further!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the incident proves to be a fine display of Mejiro Bright's incredible tenacity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Well, I was having terrific fun! It was no different from solving a puzzle. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: If you come across any other projects like this one, please let me know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Firstly, though, I think I might ask around the academy to see if anyone has anything to offer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm struck by visions of Mejiro Bright's training time rapidly vanishing, so I gently dissuade her from this new endeavor…
